method: Each of the 50 random photos (random50_images.tsv) was judged by eye on a before/after sheet: human boxes before, final boxes after both passes (Haiku 5.5 tiled v2 + review v2, merge policy 'review' as run, before the three fixes). better / same / worse = the final annotation is closer / as close / further from the annotation rules than the human one.
